<b>Drapelords</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Drapefly|Drapeflies]] that have grown larger by eating plenty and living longer than their smaller kin.<ref>Drapelord [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Elder Drapefly grown big from age and consumption. Its heavy body allows it to hit much harder than its younger companions."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Drapelords attempt to constantly keep distance from [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] in between attacks, and fly to slightly different positions depending on the attack they are about to use:
* <b>Swoop:</b> Flies farther away horizontally or diagonally from Hornet first, then rears back slightly before swooping in a straight line at her, pulling upwards as it nears the ground.
* <b>Divebomb:</b> Flies high above Hornet, then dives downwards towards her.

Drapelords deal contact damage of {{Damage|2}} for all attacks.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Drapelords have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Swooping and feeding...
* Hiding, hiding...
* Larger, hide away!
* Smaller, catch the prey!
}}

== Location ==
Drapelords can be found in the eastern part of the [[Memorium]], on the bridge leading to the [[Putrified Ducts]] during and after the <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> wish has been promised. Outside of this wish, these enemies have a random chance to spawn upon re-entering the room; however, resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] is not required to reset them. One also spawns every time the room is entered and the flock is triggered in the open area above the [[Whispering Vaults]] in [[Act 3]].

== Trivia ==
*Drapelords are heavily inspired by bats, and are named large Citadel bats internally.
*Drapelords constantly shed particles while flying, which are the same particles that curtains and rags break into when destroyed.
